semantics.progression: Core1 map -> Core1A construction -> Core1B reconstruction

microtopics.subject: Mathematics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Read a*x + b = c as a statement that is true for some values of the unknown and false for others, rather than as an instruction to work out a left-hand side.

microtopics.subject: Mathematics
microtopics.inferential_jump: See each manipulation as an operation applied to both sides whose reversibility is what guarantees no solution is gained or lost.

microtopics.subject: Mathematics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Treat the exact rational and its truncated decimal as two different numbers, and use substitution to show the difference rather than asserting it.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Current is a rate of charge passing a boundary; charge is not used up by a resistor.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A constant-resistance Ohmic model is supported only when one device keeps the same voltage-to-current ratio across operating points while the relevant conditions are held fixed; changing the operating condition can make that model stop fitting.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Buoyant force equals the weight of displaced fluid, so submerged volume and fluid density—not the object's mass by itself—set the buoyant force.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For steady incompressible flow through one tube, the volume-flow rate is conserved, so smaller cross-sectional area requires larger flow speed.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Along a streamline in steady ideal flow, pressure, kinetic, and gravitational energy-per-volume contributions trade; a speed increase alone does not determine the pressure change unless the other contributions are controlled.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: At one field point in the Newtonian test-mass model, local g is gravitational force per unit test mass. Combining F_grav = G M m/r^2 with F_net = m a cancels the test mass, giving local acceleration proportional to M/r^2 rather than to the falling object's mass.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Within the Newtonian point-mass model, or outside a spherically symmetric source where the external reduction is valid, F = G m1 m2/r^2 uses centre-to-centre separation; masses enter linearly, distance through the inverse square, and direction remains toward the attracting source.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For the same object, mass is kept distinct from local gravitational acceleration, while weight is the gravitational force W = m g and therefore changes if local g changes.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: In the Newtonian model, the two bodies exert equal-and-opposite attractive forces on distinct receivers along the line joining their centres; support or motion state does not switch the interaction on or redirect it.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Gravitational potential energy is negative when zero is chosen at infinite separation, and changes in that energy trade with kinetic energy in orbital and escape problems.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A central gravitational force has zero torque about the source centre, so orbital angular momentum is conserved; its axial-vector direction is perpendicular to the orbital plane.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Average speed divides total path length by total time, while average velocity divides signed displacement by that same time; neither is obtained by averaging listed speeds unless the weighting justifies it.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The inward acceleration requirement v^2/r fixes only the net radial component m v^2/r; tension, friction, gravity, normal force, or combinations may supply that resultant, so 'centripetal force' must not be added as another interaction.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: One straight velocity-time segment carries all three Grade 9 kinematic equations: its slope gives v = u + at, its rectangle-plus-triangle area gives s = ut + 0.5at^2, and combining trapezoid area with the slope relation eliminates time to give v^2 = u^2 + 2as.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Distance counts the whole route travelled, while displacement records only the directed change from start to finish; a return to the start leaves zero displacement after a nonzero journey.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: On a position-time graph, segment slope is average velocity over that interval; on a velocity-time graph, segment slope is average acceleration. Graph height and graph slope answer different physical questions.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: An object moving around a circle at constant speed is still accelerating because velocity direction changes continuously; velocity is tangent, acceleration points inward, and the constant speed for one revolution is circumference divided by period: v = 2 pi r / T.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Velocity and acceleration answer different questions: velocity can be zero at one instant while a nonzero acceleration determines the change through that instant.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The one-dimensional constant-acceleration equations can be applied to each perpendicular component independently when a_x and a_y are each constant over the same interval.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Perpendicular components may be solved separately because each axis equation contains only that axis's quantities, but they still describe one object at one physical time.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: After release in the ideal near-Earth model, projectile motion is not a new set of laws: it is the same component kinematics with a_x=0 and a_y=-g (for +y upward).

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Magnetic field B is an axial vector: its direction is tied to an oriented rotation convention, and dot/cross marks encode out-of-page and into-page directions rather than particle paths.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Magnetic flux measures the component of magnetic field through an oriented area; changing the surface orientation changes flux even when B and area size stay fixed.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: When the magnetic force is perpendicular to the instantaneous velocity, it can continually turn the velocity arrow without lengthening or shortening it; the magnetic interaction redirects motion without supplying kinetic energy.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Bodies share an acceleration component only when a physical constraint keeps their relative separation fixed along that coordinate; the shared acceleration can link separate Newton-II equations, while internal partner forces cancel only if the bodies are deliberately treated as one system.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A free-body diagram contains forces acting on one chosen body only; the equal-and-opposite partner of an interaction acts on the other body and belongs on that other body's diagram.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Several nonzero forces can act on one body while their directed sum is zero; the motion responds to the net result rather than to the mere presence of forces.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A force-based account depends on the observer: a non-accelerating observer uses the physical interaction forces, while an accelerating observer must add the corresponding pseudo-force convention to describe the same observed motion consistently.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Friction is a contact force along the surface that opposes relative sliding, or the tendency for relative sliding, between the contacting surfaces; it is not defined by the object's overall velocity alone.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Static friction is a responsive contact force: solve for the friction required to prevent relative slip and compare it with the limiting value mu_s N. Equality is a threshold condition, while the kinetic model is used only after sliding is established.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For one taut massless ideal string, with any redirection treated as frictionless and massless, the tension magnitude can be represented by one T throughout that same string; each body still receives its own tension force along the local string direction.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Zero net force does not mean zero motion; it means velocity does not change, so rest and steady motion are both compatible with the same condition.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For a chosen body of positive mass in the Grade 9 inertial-frame model, acceleration points with the signed net external force and satisfies F_net = m a.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For one taut inextensible string over one fixed ideal pulley, the two changing straight segment lengths add to a constant; with coordinates measured away from the pulley this gives y_A + y_B = constant and therefore a_A + a_B = 0.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: One interaction produces two partner forces of equal magnitude and opposite direction, but they act on different bodies and therefore do not cancel in a single body's net-force sum.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A repeated stream converts a momentum change per item into a momentum change per unit time: if each fixed-mass item receives signed Delta p_item and R such items are ejected per second, the average force on the ejecta is R Delta p_item; the launcher receives the opposite interaction force, so a stationary launcher requires an external holding force that balances that recoil.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The equation 1/v + 1/u = 1/f does not replace the ray picture: signed u, v and f must refer to the same mirror geometry and the formula is used only within the paraxial/small-angle model.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Mirror magnification is not merely 'times bigger': m = h_i/h_o = -v/u is signed, so |m| gives relative size while the sign records erect versus inverted orientation under the declared convention.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Angles in specular reflection are measured from the surface normal, and the reflected ray leaves with the same angle to that normal as the incident ray.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: An image location is determined by where reflected rays actually meet or where their backward extensions appear to meet; virtual describes ray geometry, not whether a camera can record it.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The Cartesian sign convention turns a mirror diagram into signed distances and heights; the signs come from declared directions, not from memorized object/image labels.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A small set of principal-ray rules are not independent tricks: any valid pair for the same object point and spherical mirror must locate the same image point within the model.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The lens equation is a signed coordinate model for the same paraxial image already constrained by the ray diagram; it is not an isolated formula or a mirror relation with copied signs.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: One signed ratio links longitudinal image placement and transverse image orientation: magnitude gives relative size while sign distinguishes erect from inverted.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Power compresses focal-length strength into an inverse-metre quantity, so both the metre conversion and focal-length sign are essential.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Several principal-ray rules are alternative constraints on one thin-lens ray bundle; any valid pair must locate the same image point.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The bend is a normal-referenced consequence of entering a medium with a different light speed/index; a parallel-sided slab applies the rule at two boundaries.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The same material property that reduces light speed determines the normal-referenced angle relation across a boundary.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: In an ideal oscillator, energy shifts between motion and displacement storage while the total stays fixed; the energy state is the same at equal-magnitude displacements on opposite sides, so the kinetic-potential pattern repeats twice during one full displacement cycle.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: An oscillation is organized around a stable equilibrium: when displaced, the system has a tendency that points back toward that equilibrium.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Rotational inertia depends on how mass is distributed relative to the chosen axis, not on total mass alone.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Angular momentum and torque must be taken about the same specified origin; zero net external torque about that origin makes total angular momentum there constant.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Pure rolling couples translation and rotation so that the point touching a stationary surface is instantaneously at rest relative to that surface.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: For bodies rolling without slipping, how mass is distributed relative to size controls how gravitational energy divides between translation and rotation, so total mass alone does not decide which body accelerates more.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A lever, pulley or inclined plane should be analysed by its input/output force, direction and distance tradeoff rather than by a memorized claim that every simple machine reduces force.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Mechanical advantage is the dimensionless same-state force ratio MA = F_load/F_effort; a practical demonstration must measure both forces for one steady setup before forming the ratio, and the result says nothing by itself about efficiency.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A simple machine can reduce effort force or change its direction by requiring a different input distance; in the ideal model input work equals useful output work.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: In a simple sound wave through a fluid, neighboring particles oscillate locally mainly parallel to propagation, creating alternating high-density/high-pressure compressions and low-density/low-pressure rarefactions while the disturbance advances.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Frequency controls pitch for heard tones, sound strength/intensity is a different loudness dimension, and humans usually hear only a finite frequency band—approximately 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz for typical young hearing—whose limits vary between people and with age.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Reflected-sound timing measures an outward-and-return path. One-way range is half that path for a stationary simple geometry; whether a return is heard as a distinct echo versus reverberation depends on delay/conditions rather than one universal distance constant.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A string, stretched membrane or enclosed air column can vibrate and launch a mechanical disturbance into nearby matter; sound then propagates through gases, liquids or solids, but not through a vacuum because there are no material particles to transmit the disturbance.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A spatial graph gives wavelength from repeat distance, a temporal graph gives period from repeat time, amplitude comes from vertical extent, f=1/T, and for one wave in one medium/state v=fλ; changing medium can change v.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A system contains internal energy, while heat and work name energy transferred across its boundary; a body does not contain 'heat'.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Internal energy is a state function: its change depends only on endpoint states, while heat and work can differ between paths connecting the same endpoints.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Over a complete thermodynamic cycle the system returns to its initial state, so net internal-energy change is zero and net heat balances net work; the directed pressure-volume loop records the sign of net work.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A heat engine cannot convert all absorbed heat into work; even an ideal reversible engine between finite-temperature reservoirs has a maximum efficiency set by those reservoir temperatures.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A magnitude-and-angle description and a signed perpendicular-component pair can represent the same vector. Projection converts between those representations; it does not by itself describe how a vector such as velocity changes later in time.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Vector addition preserves direction information by combining each axis independently; magnitude-only addition is only valid in special collinear cases.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: A requested resultant direction can be translated into a component condition, such as zero along one axis, and that condition can be solved before any magnitude or travel-time calculation.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Swapping which directed quantity comes first in a subtraction reverses the result's direction while leaving its length unchanged.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Direction recovery is two-stage: component signs locate the quadrant or axis, while inverse tangent of the positive component-magnitude ratio supplies only an acute reference angle to place inside that quadrant.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Dividing every component of the same nonzero vector by its positive magnitude removes units and scale while preserving the component ratio and therefore the direction.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The component pair and v_x i-hat + v_y j-hat are two notations for the same 2-D vector; coefficients carry the same signs and units as the original components.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The Grade 9 energy expressions follow from previously owned mechanics: constant-force work plus Newton/kinematics yields the change in kinetic energy, while a controlled lift against near-Earth weight yields the increase m g h in gravitational potential energy.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Work, kinetic energy, near-Earth gravitational potential-energy change, work-energy and mechanical-energy conservation are linked bookkeeping statements with explicit body/system, frame/reference and model conditions; K+U conservation is only the zero-nonconservative-transfer special case.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Energy conservation is broader than K+U conservation: after the system boundary and energy stores/transfers are declared, K+U may be treated as constant only when no non-conservative or unaccounted dissipative/external transfer changes that mechanical account.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The combined work of all acting forces determines the direction of kinetic-energy change: positive net work increases it, zero net work leaves it unchanged, and negative net work decreases it.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Potential energy can replace the work bookkeeping for an interaction only when the relevant energy change is fixed by the endpoints; path-dependent friction must remain an explicit transfer.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Average power uses total work over a positive interval, while instantaneous power needs force and velocity information at the same instant; equal total work does not imply equal power.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Work depends on how a force points relative to the actual displacement: along the motion gives positive work, opposite gives negative work, and a perpendicular force gives zero work.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Subtract two relative-position equations before dividing by a common time interval.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Recognise that the simple subtraction relation assumes both frames are nonrotating and non-relativistic; naming when it needs qualification is itself the (bounded) research task, not deriving the replacement mathematics.

cross_progression_findings.detail: The canonical concept is claimed by neither Core1A nor Core1B teaching routes.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Reconcile the algebraic result with reversal of the observer vector in a geometric construction.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: "Where is it?" has no answer until you say measured from what. Position is a relation, not a property of the object.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Replace two positions from an origin by the displacement from B to A.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: See P - Q as P + (-Q): reverse Q's arrowhead without changing its length, then apply tail-to-head addition.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: The physical vector stays fixed when axes are redeclared; only the signed numerical description changes according to the declared positive directions.

microtopics.subject: Physics
microtopics.inferential_jump: Equal magnitude alone does not determine a vector because direction is part of the quantity.
